documents.title: INTIMATION FOR RESCHEDULING OF 60TH ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF THE COMPANY ON 26TH AUGUST 2026 (WEDNESDAY) AT 12:00 NOON (IST)

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) reported record-breaking operational performance for FY26, achieving its highest-ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT and record production levels for diesel, petrol, and LPG. Management highlighted a strong financial position with low debt levels and emphasized their focus on operational efficiency, energy conservation, and value-added product expansion. Despite global uncertainties and market volatility, the company maintains a positive outlook, supported by long-term crude supply agreements and ongoing strategic projects like the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS facility. The company remains committed to shareholder returns, having declared a total dividend of INR 62 per share for the year. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported resilient operational performance for Q4 and FY25, achieving high capacity utilization despite scheduled maintenance shutdowns.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the current momentum to continue into the new financial year.
demand_outlook.quote: To summarize, we continue to deliver resilient operational and financial performance and see the momentum to continue in the new financial year as well.

demand_outlook.claim: The southern market has a clear shortfall in Motor Spirit (MS) where production is less than demand by close to 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: Southern market growth projections show MS demand growing at around 4%-5% and HSD at 3%.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as others are concerned, we have seen the southern market to be mostly aligned to the national growth projection. Like MS, they are projecting 6% and here we see around 4%-5%. HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing INR 1,600 crores in a Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project and INR 400 crores in a retail outlet project.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores. The retail outlet project is INR400 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to spend approximately INR 500 crores annually on normal maintenance capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Maintenance CAPEX is expected to remain in the Rs. 200-250 crore range.
capex_expansion.quote: Our maintenance CAPEX remains Rs. 200-250 crore range, and the next year forecast also, we feel the CAPEX will be in that range.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the CBR project is Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: The new refinery capacity is approximately 9 million metric tons with a petrochemical intensity of 6% for polypropylene.
capex_expansion.quote: The new refinery capital cost is Rs 36,000 Crore approximately, 9 million metric ton capacity and petrochemical intensity of 6% and which is PP, polypropylene.

margins_costs.claim: The core GRM for Q4 was $10.3 per barrel.
The full year GRM for 2024-25 was $4.22 per barrel compared to $8.64 per barrel in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: The inventory gain for the quarter was $0.66 per barrel, amounting to Rs. 125 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only.

margins_costs.claim: The fuel and loss for the year as a whole came down to 8.51%.
margins_costs.quote: I must place it that if you remember our Energy Indexes and our Fuel and Loss Indexes were quite high 2-3 years back and we went to a roadmap where we said on a sustained basis, we will bring it down to very efficient levels and in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

margins_costs.claim: CPCL reported its Total GRM and Core GRM figures across multiple financial periods.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a record crude throughput of 11.71 MMT in FY26, representing 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity

orders_capacity.claim: The company is adding a new unit for Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS with a capacity of 250 KTPA.
orders_capacity.quote: My new unit will take me to a 250,000, 250 KTPA in Group 2, Group 3 capacity, and that will be a fresh addition.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity and this must be seen with respect to the turnaround that has happened during the year

orders_capacity.claim: Crude throughput for Quarter 4 was 2.974 MMT, which is 113% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: and coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's net debt is less than INR 1,000 crores, with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores. If we consider net borrowing, the debt ratio is only 0.09, which is less than 0.1.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR 54 per share, bringing the total dividend for the year to INR 62 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: When I turn to leverage position, the debt equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: Total debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores and net worth is at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024. Net worth is at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified logistical constraints and crude oil price volatility as potential challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to complete the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project and retail outlet project over the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company does not anticipate any major maintenance and inspection (M&I) activities in the first 6 months of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: First, reply to you , in the first 6 months, we don't see any M&I.

management_commitments.claim: CPCL's roadmap on a sustained basis is to bring fuel and loss down to very efficient levels.
management_commitments.quote: I must place it that if you remember our Energy Indexes and our Fuel and Loss Indexes were quite high 2-3 years back and we went to a roadmap where we said on a sustained basis, we will bring it down to very efficient levels

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to improve further on capacity utilization levels, energy intensity index, and fuel efficiency on a continuous basis.
management_commitments.quote: But yes, on the operational side, we intend to improve further on a capacity utilisation levels, on energy intensity index and fuel efficiency, we would improve on a continuous basis.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
